Bounded calibration CI/guard continuation committed locally as 4bc68c5d67af92e1aec012f216899a1b1708d5e3 atop 446e96b8072622a3da2116a16f7d118494c9a568; execution/calibration worktree clean, no push, no confirmation launch, no ticket closure. Owned 17-file commit includes paired regular-moment candidate, quantitative Step 0 controls, inverse-moment undefined-mass policy, pre-fit launch guard, protocol/preflight and receipts.

Scientific HOLD is stronger after independent controls: exact favorable Normal/scaled-chi-square ratio F-TOST at family alpha .001/150 has no passing interval at R2000 (df400/800); R5000 nominal marginal power .480067/.482056. Independent R F-density integration agreed within 8.6e-14 and independently verified extreme F tails. Candidate paired-influence Gaussian family max uses 200000 draws, tail .0009 plus conservative order-statistic MC error .0001, but nine synthetic controls at R5000 gave 24/4000 simultaneous misses (0.006; one-sided 95% CP upper .008428), including 21 matched-moment lower-tail misses. Target .001 fails. Source gates all regular pass/fail decisions Unresolved, with candidate intervals labeled, no supported d_eff bound, dCor set [0,1]/joint Unresolved, and conditional group transfer Unresolved. Original pilot d_inv/undefined mass preserved. Step 0 synthetic confidence-set classifier separates compatible, scale-only incompatible and matched-moment lower-tail incompatible; 126/200 partially undefined bootstrap draws in regression are retained, not finite-only.

Verification: calibration suite 9/9 JVM and 9/9 Scala.js, logs calibration-ci-jvm-02.log and calibration-ci-js-01.log exit0. Direct frozen-JVM smoke rejects eight invalid confirmation launches before either fit gate/output and launcher rejects mismatched protocol hash before process; confirmation-guard-smoke.json. Negative preflight rejects missing/duplicate rows, inconsistent budgets, reused seeds and failed regular cells; preflight-negative-controls.json. Synthetic full 50-cell/300-coordinate input retains all rows with inferential statuses Unresolved. Candidate 86 inclusive seed ranges disjoint from 352 historical reserved ranges. Protocol SHA256 e0146a5b63dbf851a10d4c212506d839e3e31a83d87f7b9fd865050046525b84; frozen JVM classpath manifest SHA256 be2f8f8a797eddb35eb1f67d426ab24bb01da0c9de1ec54f171cc5b9cfa16c8b; validation receipt SHA256 7b54f82c172b949ca398e8c6d5ee3b5bfc0c332457820e82978bdbf7a5070829. Preflight screening cost remains 62506.25 s (~17.36 h) before overhead.

Next owner: independent review at this SHA. Repair or restrict the failed regular-moment interval approximation and revalidate; resolve degenerate-safe dCor and inverse-moment compatibility/native transfer, excursion selection precision and native approximation. Only then consider a concrete material-cost decision. Keep confirmation HOLD; do not launch or mark calibration complete.
